title: PH pushes faster Asean intel sharing after foiled drug shipment

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines is pushing for faster intelligence-sharing and joint operations as a routine among Asean member states after information exchange helped authorities intercept a shipment of illegal drugs in Laos earlier this month. “Just this month, a shipment with more than 500 kilograms of methamphetamine bound for our shores was stopped in Laos because our information moved between countries,” said Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla in a press briefing at the 20th Ministerial Meeting on Transnational Crimes on Wednesday, “This is what we [Philippines] want to make routine across Asean, faster intelligence, indebted sharing, joint operations, and better good […]...
